_comment: THE HOSTESS'S BOOK (2026-09-27). One row a job, in the order she hands them over, every run the same. Lines are DRAFTS the author rewrites; {name} is her full name from papers.json, {drink} the drink picked when she arrives, {n} the count. The last handOver line is what the bubble quotes. Rungs never go down the list. Editing any line here changes nothing on screen until Tools/loc/data_keys.py and merge_fragments.py --update --write have run: the string table wins over this file.

quests.title: FIRST WAGE
handOver: {name}. I ran the rope on Ocean Drive back when the neon still meant something.
This room's been dark a long time, sugar. Let's see if you can keep a light on.
Make me {n} rounds of {drink}, exactly the way the book says. Then we talk money.
done: By the book, every one. My old boss would've hired you on the spot.
That's your first wage. Don't frame it. Spend it on the room.

quests.title: STEADY HANDS
handOver: Anybody can pour. The ones they remember pour to the line.
Give me {n} perfect pours. Every band dead on, no guessing.
done: Now that's a steady hand. The book trusts you with its numbers now.

quests.title: A CLEAN NIGHT
handOver: One night. Nobody walks out, nothing wrong goes over the bar.
Sounds easy. It never is. One clean night, sugar.
done: Not one walk-out, not one wrong glass. That's a bar, honey.

quests.title: SOMETHING ON THE WALLS
handOver: These walls are bare as a Monday. People drink with their eyes first.
Hang a picture over the back bar. The market opens when the doors shut.
done: There. Now it looks like somebody lives here.

quests.title: TALK OF THE STREET
handOver: The street's starting to notice. Half a star and they'll say our name.
Get us to half a star. The counter gets ice and a lemon when we do.
done: Half a star. The street talks. Ice and lemon are on the counter.

quests.title: COLD AND TWISTED
handOver: Now they'll ask for ice. They'll ask for a twist.
Give {n} of them exactly what they asked for. Cold and twisted.
done: Cold, twisted, and nobody sent one back.

quests.title: A ROOM WORTH SITTING IN
handOver: The drinks are getting good. The room isn't keeping up.
Get the room to one full medal. Walls, floor, light, your call.
done: Look at this place. I'd stay for a second round.

quests.title: THE BLOCK'S BEST
handOver: One star is the block's best, and the block has rules.
Get us one star and the door is yours. Cards, kids, fakes, the lot.
done: The block's best. Watch the door now. I mean it.

quests.title: AN EYE ON THE DOOR
handOver: Somebody's going to try it. A kid, a borrowed card, a bad fake.
Read the card. When it's wrong, show them the door. Once, and right.
done: Right call. The state says thanks, and so do I.

quests.title: ON THE RIM
handOver: Salt for the sours, sugar for the sweet tooth. They'll ask.
Rim {n} glasses the way they asked. Clean edge, no clumps.
done: Pretty rims. Miami loves a pretty rim.

quests.title: HOUSE PROUD
handOver: The room caps the night, sugar. A tired room drags good drinks down.
Get the room to two full medals and watch the stars follow.
done: Two medals. This room could hold a wedding.

quests.title: TALK OF THE TOWN
handOver: Two stars and the whole town knows the name.
Get us there. You'll get a spoon, the jars and a second tap.
done: The town's talking. Bring the spoon out.

quests.title: STIRRED, NOT SHAKEN
handOver: Some drinks bruise. You don't shake those, you stir them, slow.
{n} rounds of {drink}, stirred like you mean it.
done: Silk. That's how a stirred drink should sit.

quests.title: A PROPER HEAD
handOver: Beer's not a cocktail, but it's still a craft.
Pull me {n} pints with a proper head. Lean it, then straighten it.
done: Now that's a pint. Two fingers of foam and not a drop more.

quests.title: THE CITY'S BEST
handOver: Three stars. The city's best. I've seen two rooms get there.
Neither one's open anymore. Let's be the third, and let's stay open.
done: The city's best. Say it out loud, it's true.

quests.title: THE TOP SHELF
handOver: Your best page is the one they cross the causeway for.
Pour {n} rounds of {drink}. Make every one worth the drive.
done: People drove across the bay for that. I watched them.

quests.title: THE COUNTRY'S BEST
handOver: Four stars. The magazines call that the country's best.
They'll send somebody. You won't know who. Pour like it's every one.
done: Four stars. My mother would've cried. I nearly did.

quests.title: THE BEST THERE IS
handOver: Five stars. Nobody I ever worked for got there.
This is the last thing I'll ask of you. Five stars.
done: Five stars. The best there is. I knew it on the first night.

say: That's the whole list, sugar. You don't need me reading it to you anymore.
I'll still drop by. Somebody has to drink the good stuff.
The next one waits till we're {rung}. Keep pouring.
